# Token-Saving Coding Rules

* Keep responses short and focused. Do not explain obvious code changes.
* Inspect only files relevant to the current task.
* Never read the entire project unless explicitly requested.
* Do not repeatedly reread files already inspected unless they changed.
* Avoid scanning node_modules, dist, build, coverage, .git, and generated files unless required.
* Use targeted searches instead of dumping entire files.
* Make the smallest necessary code changes.
* Do not rewrite working code or refactor unrelated files.
* Avoid creating unnecessary documentation, plans, or artifacts.
* Do not use the browser or web search unless the task requires external information.
* Run only relevant tests. Do not repeat successful tests unnecessarily.
* Fix errors using the actual error message and relevant source code.
* Do not repeatedly explain the same issue.
* Ask before performing a large refactor.
* At completion, report only: changes, tests, remaining issues.
